name: Quantgroup Holding Limited
summary: Quantgroup Holding Limited, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Beijing, runs online marketplaces in China through its subsidiaries. Its Yangxiaomie platform links third-party suppliers to shoppers in categories such as electronics, food, appliances and cosmetics, while Consumption Guide is an online-to-offline platform that helps automobile retailers turn web traffic into showroom purchases. It also sells advertisement placement.
